_comment: Single source of truth for TT weapons. Run tools/build_content.py after editing.

weapons.name: Frontier Cleaver
weapons.story: Ch1 · Crafted in the ash fields
weapons.lore: Ugly. Effective. Like everything out here.
weapons.ability_text: Animal kills drop +1 food; hostile kills have a 10% chance to drop a Bone Shard.

weapons.name: Rustbite Karambit
weapons.lore: Ember scouts carried these. Small enough to hide, cruel enough to matter.
weapons.ability_text: After a successful dodge, your next hit within 1s deals +2 damage and makes the target flinch.

weapons.name: Ashfang Karambit
weapons.story: Ch2 · Forged by Doran from a Hollow Alpha fang
weapons.lore: Curved like the ash dunes. Bites twice.
weapons.ability_text: Hooking slash that drags you behind the target; your next hit within 2s is a guaranteed crit and ignites (12s cooldown).

weapons.name: Accord Longsword
weapons.lore: Raised over the first wall we built.
weapons.ability_text: Overhead strike granting you and allies within 8 blocks Strength I + Resistance I for 6s (20s cooldown).

weapons.name: Gnawblade
weapons.lore: They know the smell of what you've cut.
weapons.ability_text: Hits mark the target for 8s; your tamed rats focus it and deal +25% damage to it.

weapons.name: Rootstring Bow
weapons.lore: Every arrow you loose, the forest remembers.
weapons.ability_text: Fully charged arrows plant a 3x3 briar patch that roots enemies for 4s (8s cooldown).

weapons.name: Thornwatch Halberd
weapons.lore: The Thornwatch never retreats. It plants.
weapons.ability_text: Wide sweep leaving a 6-block thorn line for 5s (2 dmg/s + slow) (15s cooldown).

weapons.name: Cogwright Breaker
weapons.story: Ch3-5 · Pell of the Cogwright Guild
weapons.lore: Steam remembers every blow. Let it answer.
weapons.ability_text: Each hit stores pressure (max 5); sneak-attack releases a knock-up slam dealing 2 dmg per pressure in 4 blocks.

weapons.name: Prism Ward Staff
weapons.story: Ch5 · Ilsabet of the Lumen Conclave
weapons.lore: Light bends. So should every arrow aimed at you.
weapons.ability_text: Casting any spell grants a 3s barrier that reflects the next projectile (10s cooldown).

weapons.name: Hollowbane Tachi
weapons.story: Ch4 · Dropped by your Hollow self
weapons.lore: It was always yours. You just hadn't faced the one holding it.
weapons.ability_text: Iaijutsu line cut: +100% vs Hollowed, strips invisibility and Hollow shields (18s cooldown).

weapons.name: Cinder Crown
weapons.story: Ch6 · Forged from the core of Ignis
weapons.lore: A king of fire fell. His crown did not go out.
weapons.ability_text: Dragging ground slash sending a 10-block line of erupting flame forward (16s cooldown).

weapons.name: Frostmaw Fang
weapons.lore: Cold enough to stop a heartbeat, curved enough to find it.
weapons.ability_text: Hits add frost stacks; at 5 the target freezes for 1.5s and takes 6 bonus damage (10s per-target cooldown).

weapons.name: Wroughtnaut Bulwark
weapons.lore: It guarded an empty hall for a hundred years. Now it guards you.
weapons.ability_text: A perfect guard reflects 100% of blocked melee damage and staggers the attacker for 1s.

weapons.name: Skyreach Spear
weapons.lore: The sky does not fall. It descends — on purpose.
weapons.ability_text: Launch 8 blocks up; attacking mid-air dives into an AoE plunge with no fall damage (14s cooldown).

weapons.name: Hydra's Tri-Edge
weapons.lore: Cut one head, two grow. Cut three, it's over.
weapons.ability_text: Every 3rd consecutive hit on a target triggers a triple slash (3x3 dmg) and Poison II for 4s.

weapons.name: Undergloom Scythe
weapons.lore: Down here, nothing dies alone. It's harvested.
weapons.ability_text: A swing that hits 3+ enemies heals you 2 HP per enemy hit (max once per 2s).

weapons.name: Sculkheart Dagger
weapons.lore: It cuts once. The dark cuts again.
weapons.ability_text: 1s after each hit, a silent echo repeats 50% of the damage. Kills make no sound.

weapons.name: Choirbreaker Gauntlets
weapons.story: Ch8 · Reverse-engineered from a Choir Herald
weapons.lore: They sing in machine-code. Teach them silence.
weapons.ability_text: Charged punch releasing an EMP: stuns Iron Choir villains and machines for 3s, interrupts powers (20s cooldown).

weapons.name: Harbinger's Railblade
weapons.lore: Built to herald the end. Repurposed to postpone it.
weapons.ability_text: Charge 1.5s, then fire a 20-block piercing beam dealing 12 damage (18s cooldown).

weapons.name: Abyssal Longbow
weapons.lore: The deep always takes back what it's owed.
weapons.ability_text: Charged arrows pierce 3 enemies and drag them 4 blocks toward the impact point.

weapons.name: Crownshard Karambits
weapons.story: Ch10 · The karambit line, fused with Crown Shards
weapons.lore: Seven shards. Two blades. One heartbeat.
weapons.ability_text: Blink between up to 3 enemies in 10 blocks, slashing each (3x8 dmg); untargetable while blinking (22s cooldown).

weapons.name: Thornecutter
weapons.lore: Made for one neck. It will not be sheathed until it finds it.
weapons.ability_text: Up to +40% damage vs bosses as their health drops; cleave removes one boss buff or phase shield (25s cooldown).

weapons.name: Emberhold Oathblade
weapons.story: Ch12 · Emberhold becomes a Legendary Kingdom
weapons.lore: The first wall. The last oath.
weapons.ability_text: +1 damage per Emberhold Town Hall level (max +5); kills inside your colony heal nearby citizens and guards.
